text: Hi, I’m Katie. Here’s a quick tour of your Tringg dashboard.
This is your overview: today’s bookings, pending requests, calls handled, and your no-show rate.
Your agent Sofie is live. Call this number any time to try her yourself.
Recent calls appear here with a short AI summary. Let’s open the full list.
Calls shows every conversation: total calls, reservations captured, and average duration.
Filter by outcome. Open Completed, Transferred for calls handed to your team, FAQ for general questions, or Failed for calls that didn’t go through.
Open any call for an AI summary, tags for what the caller wanted, and the details Sofie captured.
Scroll down to play the recording and read the full transcript.
Reservations is your inbox. Switch between today, declined, and expired bookings.
And filter by status, date, or party size.
Agents is where you manage your voice agent. Open Sofie to set her name, greeting, and voice. Right now, she speaks in my voice.
Everything else lives in Settings, from your profile menu.
Use the outlet switcher to move between all outlets and a single outlet. Settings apply per outlet.
Basic info holds your address, map location, and timezone. This is what Sofie tells callers.
Hours and booking rules set when Sofie takes reservations, including special dates and closures.
FAQ and knowledge is what Sofie answers from. Open any question to review or edit its answer.
And Billing shows your plan and what’s included.
That’s your Tringg dashboard. Thanks for watching.
